concerns.text: SC-005's first clause — 'retrieve and successfully process ≥ 95 % of metallic-glass entries returned by the APIs after filtering' — has no task that computes or verifies the 95 % collection ratio. T002's verification checks schema validity and missing descriptor values, and only logs counts and the <500-entry warning. Add to T002 (or T009) a computed completeness ratio (collected/returned-after-filter) recorded in an artifact and checked against the ≥95 % threshold.

Plan Phase 7 element 'Lint all code with ruff (line length < 88, no unused imports)' has no covering task. The revision notes say scaffolding/lint-config tasks were removed as rejected, but the plan still declares linting as a phase deliverable; either add a lightweight lint check to T009's verification ('all tests pass' → 'all tests pass and ruff check is clean') or note the plan element as intentionally dropped.
